description: This interface defines the contract for a notes repository in a C# application, specifying methods for CRUD operations and existence checks for note entities.

classes.name: INotesRepository
classes.description: An interface providing methods to interact with note data storage, including retrieving all notes, fetching by ID, creating, updating, deleting, and checking existence.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if a note with the specified ID exists.

calls: Task<Note?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)
Task<Note> CreateAsync(Note note, CancellationToken ct = default)
Task<bool> UpdateAsync(Note note, CancellationToken ct = default)
Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)
Task<bool> ExistsAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)
